executionOutcome.description: COMPLETED: the planned action ran to the point of observation. BLOCKED: the target or a safety control prevented the action from proceeding — BLOCKED does NOT automatically mean safe (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §8). ERRORED: a technical failure prevented completion. INCONCLUSIVE_EXECUTION: ran, but evidence is insufficient to classify the result. This is completely separate from whether a Finding exists.

execution.description: An Execution is not a Finding (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §7).

target_context.description: Which in-scope target this specific execution was against, if scope covers multiple targets.

safety_constraint_context.description: Free-text reference to the applicable Safety Constraint (THREAT_MODEL.md §10), e.g. 'dry-run' / 'proof-of-action per ASA-MTH-001'.
